# Curcio & Casciato

> Chicago-based personal injury law firm specializing in catastrophic injuries, medical malpractice, and wrongful death claims with Super Lawyers-recognized attorneys.

Curcio & Casciato is a full-service personal injury law firm serving Chicago and Cook County with experienced trial lawyers and appellate counsel. The firm handles complex cases including traumatic brain injuries, spinal cord damage, amputations, and medical malpractice claims.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Catastrophic Injuries
- Medical Malpractice
- Traumatic Brain Injury

- Chicago Personal Injury Attorney
- Wrongful Death
- Trial Litigation
- Negligence Claims
- Injury Compensation
- Super Lawyers
- Cook County
- Appellate Counsel
- Amputation Claims
- Paralysis Representation
